## ChatPlacement

Supporting declaration used by a public type. This is not an additional runtime API or SDK helper.

A chat's place in the library, chosen when it starts.

```ts
export interface ChatPlacement {
    subjectId: string;
    topicId?: string;
    startMode: "scratch" | "check";
}
```
